mapper.sql: (select t0.id from oms_ticket t0 join cms_activity a0 on a0.id = t0.owner_id and t0.owner_type = 2 where a0.topic_id = #{topicId} and t0.del_flag = 0 order by t0.start_time, t0.id)
mapper.select: select r.id registration_id, r.member_id, r.payment_status, r.registration_status, t.start_time ticket_start, t.end_time last_session_end, (select min(ra0.create_time) from refund_application ra0 where ra0.source_type = 'registration' and ra0.source_id = r.id and ra0.del_flag = 0) refund_requested_at, (select min(ra.create_time) from refund_application ra where ra.source_type = 'registration' and ra.source_id = r.id and ra.payout_status in (1, 3, 4) and ra.del_flag = 0) refund_time, case when exists ( select 1 from player_node_progress p where p.member_id = r.member_id and p.activity_id = r.owner_id and p.topic_id = #{topicId} and p.checkin_time is not null and p.del_flag = 0 ) then 1 else 0 end arrived, (select count(distinct rd.chapter_id) from redemption rd where rd.registration_id = r.id and rd.topic_id = #{topicId} and rd.status = 'ACTIVE') redeemed_count, (select count(1) from cms_topic_chapter c where c.topic_id = #{topicId} and coalesce(c.required, 1) = 1) required_count, (select max(rd2.create_time) from redemption rd2 where rd2.registration_id = r.id and rd2.topic_id = #{topicId} and rd2.status = 'ACTIVE') last_redemption_at, case when exists ( select 1 from cms_topic tp join club cl on cl.id = tp.club_id where tp.id = #{topicId} and ( exists (select 1 from ums_member_follow f where f.member_id = r.member_id and f.follow_member_id = cl.member_id and f.create_time between (select min(t3.start_time) from oms_ticket t3 join cms_activity a3 on a3.id=t3.owner_id and t3.owner_type=2 where a3.topic_id=#{topicId} and t3.del_flag=0) and timestampadd(day, 7, (select min(t4.start_time) from oms_ticket t4 join cms_activity a4 on a4.id=t4.owner_id and t4.owner_type=2 where a4.topic_id=#{topicId} and t4.del_flag=0))) or exists (select 1 from club_member cm where cm.club_id = cl.id and cm.member_id = r.member_id and cm.status = 1 and cm.del_flag = 0 and cm.join_time between (select min(t5.start_time) from oms_ticket t5 join cms_activity a5 on a5.id=t5.owner_id and t5.owner_type=2 where a5.topic_id=#{topicId} and t5.del_flag=0) and timestampadd(day, 7, (select min(t6.start_time) from oms_ticket t6 join cms_activity a6 on a6.id=t6.owner_id and t6.owner_type=2 where a6.topic_id=#{topicId} and t6.del_flag=0))) ) ) then 1 else 0 end joined_within_seven_days from cms_registration r join cms_activity a on a.id = r.owner_id and r.owner_type = 2 join oms_ticket t on t.id = r.ticket_id join topic_ticket on topic_ticket.id = t.id where a.topic_id = #{topicId} and r.purchase_kind = 3 and t.del_flag = 0

select e.registration_id, e.chapter_id, min(p.checkin_time) queue_joined_at, min(rd.create_time) service_started_at from registration_entitlement e join cms_registration r on r.id = e.registration_id join cms_activity a on a.id = r.owner_id and r.owner_type = 2 and a.topic_id = #{topicId} join topic_ticket on topic_ticket.id = r.ticket_id left join cms_topic_node n on n.chapter_id = e.chapter_id and n.topic_id = #{topicId} left join player_node_progress p on p.member_id = r.member_id and p.activity_id = r.owner_id and p.topic_id = #{topicId} and p.node_id = n.id and p.del_flag = 0 left join redemption rd on rd.registration_id = r.id and rd.chapter_id = e.chapter_id and rd.topic_id = #{topicId} and rd.status = 'ACTIVE' where e.topic_id = #{topicId} and (p.checkin_time is not null or rd.id is not null) group by e.registration_id, e.chapter_id

select distinct later.member_id, later.payment_time from cms_registration later where later.payment_status = 2 and later.registration_status = 2 and later.payment_time is not null and exists ( select 1 from cms_registration original join cms_activity oa on oa.id = original.owner_id and original.owner_type = 2 where oa.topic_id = #{topicId} and original.purchase_kind = 3 and original.member_id = later.member_id ) and not exists ( select 1 from cms_activity current_topic where later.owner_type = 2 and current_topic.id = later.owner_id and current_topic.topic_id = #{topicId} )

select e.chapter_id, count(distinct e.registration_id) in_store_load from registration_entitlement e join cms_registration r on r.id = e.registration_id and r.payment_status = 2 and r.registration_status = 2 join cms_activity a on a.id = r.owner_id and r.owner_type = 2 and a.topic_id = #{topicId} join topic_ticket on topic_ticket.id = r.ticket_id join cms_topic_node n on n.chapter_id = e.chapter_id and n.topic_id = #{topicId} join player_node_progress p on p.member_id = r.member_id and p.activity_id = r.owner_id and p.topic_id = #{topicId} and p.node_id = n.id and p.checkin_time is not null and p.del_flag = 0 where e.topic_id = #{topicId} and e.status = 0 group by e.chapter_id

select count(distinct complaint.reporter_member_id) from coop_complaint complaint join cms_registration registration on registration.id = complaint.registration_id and registration.owner_type = 2 and registration.payment_status = 2 and registration.registration_status = 2 join cms_activity activity on activity.id = registration.owner_id and activity.topic_id = #{topicId} where complaint.topic_id = #{topicId} and complaint.del_flag = 0 and complaint.status = 3 and complaint.fault_ratio > 0
